description: IRON VANGUARD Campaign Map Registry. Each JSON file defines the 36x36 battlefield grid, gameMode rules (see src/game/mapRules.js), and a flat enemyPool queue (typically 24 tank names, spawning 4 initially and up to 8 simultaneously).

availableGameModes.extermination: Default mode: Victory when all enemies (and sector boss) are destroyed. Player base is strictly a Field Repair Bay.
availableGameModes.stronghold_assault: Stronghold Siege mode: Victory when the fortified Enemy Stronghold Core (E / enemyBase) guarded by enemies is destroyed.
availableGameModes.base_defense: Defense mode: Victory when all attacking waves are destroyed; Defeat if either Player tank or Allied Command HQ is destroyed.

availableTileLegend.C: CONCRETE (Hard-to-destroy reinforced concrete bunker wall, 16 HP)
availableTileLegend.W: WATER (Impassable water channel unless Hover Chassis CH4/CH5 is active)
availableTileLegend.X: HEDGEHOG (Anti-tank Czech hedgehog: impassable to tanks, projectiles fly over freely)
availableTileLegend.Q: BOXES (Four wooden supply crates, two hits; may contain Credits or Power-Ups)
availableTileLegend.D: BARREL (Explosive fuel drum / ammo depot: detonates on hit, deals massive area damage & chain reactions)
